key.name: pinned
key.description: JSON array of objects with a path field.

key.name: search-roots
key.description: JSON array of folder paths. A leading ~ means the home folder.

key.name: scan-depth
key.description: How many folder levels below each search root are scanned.

key.name: skip-dirs
key.summary: Folder names skipped by the scan

key.name: recent-sources
key.summary: Tools to read recent folders from
key.description: JSON object mapping a tool name to true or false.

key.name: max-recent
key.description: Maximum number of recent folders shown for each tool.

key.name: include-worktrees
key.description: List git worktrees as separate projects.

key.name: project-actions
key.description: JSON array of action objects with id, name, icon, template, runInTerminal, requiresRemoteDir and enabled.

key.name: server-actions
key.description: JSON array of action objects. {remoteCmd} expands to a quoted command that changes to the remote folder and starts a login shell.

key.name: default-project-action
key.description: Id of the action that runs when a project is activated.

key.name: default-server-action
key.description: Id of the action that runs when a server is activated.

key.name: server-meta
key.description: JSON object mapping a host to its remoteDir and defaultAction.

key.name: item-overrides
key.description: JSON object mapping a path to its defaultAction and hidden flag.

key.name: terminal-preset
key.description: Id of the terminal to use. Empty means the first installed one.

key.name: toggle-popup
key.summary: Shortcut to open the search popup

key.name: ssh-config-path
key.description: Path of the SSH config file that is read and edited.
